text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Park Lawn Road, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval to prohibit northbound U-turn movements at all times on Park Lawn Road, between Park Lawn Gardiner Westbound On-ramp and The Queensway.

City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit northbound U-turn movements at all times on Park Lawn Road, between Park Lawn Gardiner Westbound On-ramp and The Queensway.
